literal_meaning: নষ্ট বা ক্ষতিকর আচরণ (spoiled or harmful behavior)
figurative_meaning_en: Engaging in mischief or bad deeds
example_sentences_in_english: The child is up to mischief all day.
Stop this naughty behavior of yours.
note: Commonly used to describe playful or troublesome actions, especially in children
